questionText:
Consider the following code snippet using the fork() and wait() system calls. Assume that the code compiles and runs correctly, and that the system calls run successfully without any errors.

The total number of times the printf statement is executed is ________
explanation:
To determine the total number of times the printf statement is executed, let us analyze the loop execution starting from $x = 3$.

Iteration 1 ($x = 3$):
• Initial state: $1$ process (P0) with $x = 3$.
• fork() creates $1$ new child process. Now there are $2$ processes (P0, P1).
• Both processes execute printf. (Count = $2$)
• Both processes decrement $x$ to $2$.

Iteration 2 ($x = 2$):
• Both $2$ processes (P0, P1) execute fork(), doubling the number of processes to $4$.
• All $4$ processes execute printf. (Count = $4$)
• All $4$ processes decrement $x$ to $1$.

Iteration 3 ($x = 1$):
• All $4$ processes execute fork(), doubling the number of processes to $8$.
• All $8$ processes execute printf. (Count = $8$)
• All $8$ processes decrement $x$ to $0$.

Termination ($x = 0$):
• All $8$ processes evaluate $x > 0$ as false and exit the loop.

Total executions of printf:
$2 + 4 + 8 = 14$
